scene: Swirling glitter reveals three travel gates leading out of the workshop.
picture: Flat side view inside the workshop. The boy stands centre beside the glowing, stirred glitter vat. Far left, an open loading doorway reveals a waiting hillside chairlift. Left, a canal dock holds an idle glass-bottomed boat. Far right, French doors open to an outdoor wooden balcony where a striped hot-air balloon basket bobs.
shown: a dangling two-seat chairlift waiting at an open bay door on the far left
a transparent boat floating in an indoor canal slipway on the left
a red-striped hot-air balloon basket tethered beside an open balcony on the far right
